blocks.text: Confirmed, and thank you. The substitute mark is in, and Ashley Williams has added it to the full clearance search with the surviving candidates, so it clears on the same pass rather than a later one.

Timing on our side is unchanged. The full search for {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} runs over the coming weeks, and the written clearance report follows once the searches are complete and counsel has reviewed the risk on each mark. The report will set out, for each surviving candidate, the conflicts the searches turned up and our read of the risk, with the options each one leaves open. I will flag anything that needs a decision from you as it comes up, and not before.
For the record, our file shows Cynthia Hunter as the approver for the Jackson Inc clearance, so we will bring the report to you when it is ready. Nothing is needed from you now.
